finding: The prepared existing-data audit is complete. Its recorded observations do not identify one uniquely first causal stage at the saved time resolution. Rain remains scientifically unresolved.
limitations: Quarter-second aggregate observations cannot recover an unrecorded within-step causal order.
The original P-29/P-30 archives are exact external dependencies; they are not included in this staging packet.
The optional regression against the earlier narrower audit needs that separate pinned source.
No native app, physical system, new trajectory or solver is tested by this assembly.

Preserved archive: P32_Divergence_Onset_Audit_Completed_2026-10-02.zip. The attached files are inspection selections; they do not replace its complete runtime directory. No public archive URL or permission is implied. Full figures, historical versions and omitted dependencies remain in that archive.
Public source selections omit specified private identifiers or provenance-sensitive inputs; private originals and source hashes remain preserved.
method: The historical audit compares existing saved observables, intervals and event records under its frozen analysis plan. The packet contains that analysis source, full outputs and recorded independent checks; no analyzer or solver is executed now.
open_questions: A separately authorized finer-observation study could test causal order. It is not required to accept this audit as completed.
